verdict.rationale: Pipedream Connect is a documented embedding product. Developers use TypeScript/Python/Java SDKs and a REST API to let their own end users connect accounts, keyed by external_user_id. Their product can then make API and tool calls on those users' behalf, with usage tracked per end user. The evidence does not show the automation platform itself (the workflow builder) embedded for customers, and it never mentions white-label branding. missing for 10: explicit white-label/unbranded UI or custom-branding docs, an embeddable end-user workflow builder, independent hands-on corroboration of an embedded deployment.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed the automation platform white-label inside my own product for my customers

citations.quote: the ability for your users to easily connect their accounts without having to build any of the authorization flow or handle token storage
Pipedream provides TypeScript, Python, and Java SDKs along with a REST API to interact with the Connect service.
When you use the Connect API, you'll pass an external_user_id parameter when initiating account connections and retrieving account info.
Add Pipedream MCP to your app or agent to make tool calls on behalf of your users to 3,000+ APIs and 10,000+ tools.
Use the List usage records API to retrieve detailed Connect usage data for a given time window, including credit consumption and end user counts.
